rationale: Record an editor-open performance change that crosses these families' selectors. core/view/src/claude_bundle.cpp finds inline template <script> blocks with a string scan instead of a lazy std::regex; tag and close matching stay case-insensitive, `\b` after `script` is kept, and a body still ends at the first close. A 300,000-case differential fuzz against the regex found no mismatch. No importer lowering, DesignIR shape, capture path, renderer selection, asset format, fixture or threshold changes. Registered as watch-only so the families' coverage stays honest. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
tests: pulp-test-group-view-widgets WidgetBridge __pulpRuntimeImport__ finds inline scripts by the tag rules
